intent: Group the header's eyebrow, title, the content beside the title and the description into one text block.
typical_uses: The text block of every PageHeader, between the leading control and the actions

dont_use_when.situation: The text block of a card's header

invariants.text: PageHeaderContent is a grid of named areas - the eyebrow above, the title and the meta on one line, the description under them - so each part lands in its area whichever of the others are present.

The block grows to fill the header's row. The title's column and the meta's column are each as wide as their content, and an empty flexible column takes the rest, so an eyebrow or a description wider than both does not move the meta away from the title. When the row runs short the title and the meta share it, so a meta narrower than its share keeps its width and the title truncates, and when both are long each gets half.

anti_patterns.dont: Put PageHeaderActions inside the text block
anti_patterns.do_instead: Render PageHeaderActions as a direct child of PageHeader after the content, where it stays at the end of the header and takes a line of its own when the header is narrow

good.title: The four parts in the order they read

bad.title: The actions folded into the text block
bad.why: Inside the text block the actions have no area of their own, so the grid puts them in its first free cell: above the title when there is no eyebrow, beside the title or the meta when there is one - never on a row under the title. As a child of PageHeader they sit at the end of the header, var(--space-6) after the text.
